items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Bobby Scott told me that years ago.

ctx.x: After all is said and done?

That’s right. Well Dave McKenna, best example, how a song should be harmonized. And the hardest thing, harder than writing an arrangement, is to write a set of chords for an arrangement. Say you only have four people in the band. And now all you need is the right chord and the right bass note. Bobby Scott told me that years ago. He said, “Over night, I sat up all night trying to figure out where you wanted the bass to go.” And you’ve got to look underneath the song itself and say hey, there’s a lot of beauty…
Well I like those words, especially at 9:50 in the morning. Terrific sentiments.
